# Asset Intelligence Copilot

> A chat copilot, built for the FlytBase Hack Day Asset Health Challenge (17 Oct
> 2026), that answers operators' plain-English questions about a fleet of 200 oil
> wells with computed, evidence-backed answers rendered as generative UI (status
> cards, tables, line/bar charts, spill maps, heatmaps).

Questions are routed to deterministic analytics tools over a SQLite database
loaded from the organizers' dataset folder format; an optional Gemini planner
(free tier, OpenAI-compatible endpoint) maps questions to tools, with a
deterministic rule-based fallback so the app runs at zero cost. Production,
spill-response and compliance rules are encoded from the dataset's own manuals
and SOPs (OM-T200/OM-T350, SOP-SR, SOP-RC) and cited in answers. The copilot
keeps per-user private conversation memory, team-shared notes, first-class data
corrections with scope (inspection / well / well type), and surfaces conflicts
instead of silently resolving them.

## Links

- Live demo: https://asset-copilot-mrun.streamlit.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/Mrun25/oilops-copilot
- Write-up (system design + results): https://github.com/Mrun25/oilops-copilot/blob/main/WRITEUP.md
- Video narration script: https://github.com/Mrun25/oilops-copilot/blob/main/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md

## Key files

- app.py — Streamlit generative UI (chat, user picker, visual renderers)
- copilot/loader.py — ingests the dataset folder (fleet JSON, per-well JSONL, repair reports, manuals/SOPs) into SQLite
- copilot/engine.py — deterministic analytics and rule evaluation over SQL
- copilot/router.py — Gemini LLM planner + deterministic fallback router + chat/correction memory
- copilot/executor.py — answer composition: text, visual spec, evidence, conflict flags
- tests/verify_scenarios.py — replays all 18 example scenarios from the organizers' 03-evaluation-queries.md
- sample-data/ — the organizers' synthetic sample dataset (200 wells)

## How to run

pip install -r requirements.txt && streamlit run app.py
(no API key required; set LLM_API_KEY/LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_MODEL for the LLM planner)

## Verified capabilities

All 18 example scenarios in the organizers' evaluation guide pass end to end
(tests/verify_scenarios.py, 23/23 checks): status cards with rule-based
producing verdicts, not-producing tables, temperature charts, spill counts with
corrected detections excluded, downtime math, downtime ranking, spill maps,
area-by-month heatmaps, compliance breach detection (SR-01/02/03, RC-04, RC-02),
containment violations found in free-text repair reports, private per-user
recall, data corrections that keep originals and propagate at the right scope,
type-scoped team rules, and conflict surfacing between people and data.

All field data is synthetic, supplied by the organizers for the challenge.
